events.title: Kerala floods, June–August 2018
events.geographic_scope: Kerala state; KSDMA-hosted CWC report excerpt states severe flooding in 13 of 14 districts.
events.evidence: CWC report states IMD-reported rainfall of 2,346.6 mm against 1,649.5 mm normal (+42%) for 1 June–19 August 2018; severe spell 14–19 August.
events.source_title: CWC Study Report: Kerala Floods of August 2018, reproduced as an annex in a KSDMA report
events.relationship_to_local_observations: No date overlap: the older local rainfall series ends in 2014 and the newer observations begin in 2021. Context only; no joined labels.

events.title: Kerala flood/landslide affected period, October 2021
events.geographic_scope: Kerala state; official order declares 305 villages in 39 taluks flood/landslide affected after excess rainfall and flooding.
events.evidence: Government Order G.O.(P) No. 1/2022/DMD, dated 3 February 2022, defines the calamity period as 12–25 October 2021.
events.source_title: Government Order: Flood 2021 affected villages, taluks and districts
events.publisher: Disaster Management Department, Government of Kerala; hosted by KSDMA
events.relationship_to_local_observations: Some hourly observations overlap the dates. The order does not identify station-specific flood outcomes; overlap is context only and is not a model label.
